meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Indian winters mein **dry skin** ke liye lightweight gel ke bajay **thick cream/lotion** lena better rahega—especially **ceramides, glycerin, hyaluronic acid, shea butter** jaise ingredients dekho. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Face ke liye
### [CeraVe Moisturising Cream]()
*₹422*

**CeraVe Moisturising Cream** — bahut dry skin ke liye strong option; ceramide-based barrier support ke liye achha choice.

Budget-friendly Indian options bhi:
### [Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser]()
*₹266*

### [Dot & Key Ceramides & Hyaluronic Barrier Repair Moisturizer]()
*₹250*

### [Plum CeraSense Moisturizing Cream]()
*₹299*

### Body ke liye
Agar **legs/arms bahut dry ya flaky** ho jaate hain, richer body lotion/cream lo. Cetaphil bhi winter mein dry skin ke liye cream-type formulas recommend karta hai. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/top-body-moisturizers-for-dry-skin-relief-in-winters.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Meri simple recommendation:**  
- **Very dry skin:** CeraVe Moisturising Cream  
- **Normal-to-dry:** Re'equil Ceramide + HA  
- **Budget option:** Dot & Key Ceramide moisturizer  
- **Body:** Cetaphil Moisturising Cream / Vaseline Deep Moisture

Moisturizer **face wash/bath ke turant baad halki damp skin par** lagao; winter mein din mein 2 baar useful hai. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Agar tum mujhe **budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000)** aur **face ya body** bata do, main 2–3 best options choose karke de sakta hoon.
